gen-dafont-quantum-gf-noto-sans-kayah-li: Loose, spacious, and distinctly techy up top. Noto Sans Kayah Li follows with brush-like ends that lift away before each curve closes, so a long stretch of text flows softly.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-noto-sans-kharosht: Noto Sans Kharoshthi sets down curves that never close back on themselves, building a thick, dark stripe of lowercase through every line while Quantum stays loose above. It feels friendly and current.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-noto-sans-khmer: Glowing tube-like lines, loosely spaced. And Noto Sans Khmer keeps its small letters standing proud, almost capital-sized, so a long passage reads with generous, notched openings.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-noto-sans-khojki: Quantum looks drawn with a fixed pen, loose and techy. Noto Sans Khojki brings exits wide enough to pass light through, plus a large, clear eye on every e, and that is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-noto-sans-khudawad: Approachable from the first glance, with Quantum's strips of equal width spaced out and a compressed top. Noto Sans Khudawadi keeps capitals close to lowercase height and leaves its rounds unlatched, and Quantum earns its keep big and short.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-noto-sans-kr: Quantum's strokes hold a constant width like bent pipe, spaced loosely with short ascenders. And Noto Sans KR answers with stubby ascenders and descenders beside a big x-height, its curves left generously open.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-noto-sans-lao: Noto Sans Lao lifts its x-height well above the usual, with mouths that stay open on every curve. And Quantum sits over it with one constant stroke width, loosely spaced and clean.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-noto-sans-lao-loop: Noto Sans Lao Looped makes words read as solid blocks rather than skylines, its bowls left unfinished on one side, a quiet modern texture. Quantum handles display work; the sans handles the text.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-noto-sans-limbu: Stencil-cut letters, one steady width. Quantum is built for showing off up top, while Noto Sans Limbu uses tall-bodied small letters and gaping curves to keep running text approachable.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-noto-sans-lydian: Approachable and a touch understated, Noto Sans Lydian keeps capitals barely taller than lowercase, with openings wide as a sprung paper clip. Quantum's terminals end as wide as they began.
